_about: Tanakiera (161165, evilloli_master): translated from the game's Japanese. Global names: Nimbus (white_tiger), Melmyna (sanctuary_guard), Pur Lilie (guild_front_girl), Starview Village.
profile: A martial arts master who is both kind and terrifying. Though she possesses superhuman strength, she's a good person whose hobbies are helping and teaching others. However, her thought process and priorities are beyond human comprehension. To put it plainly, she doesn't understand the human heart.
titleCondition: Level Tanakiera to 100 and obtain her Amity Scroll

2.title: In Pursuit of Martial Mastery
2.summary: Accepting a request to subdue bandits appearing in town, Tanakiera heads to the scene, dragging along a Melmyna who tries to escape. However, the bandits turn out to be victims whose fetishes Tanakiera warped. Tanakiera keeps taking talented people as disciples, searching for someone who can reach the same heights as her.

3.title: A Good Time
3.summary: Tanakiera asks Alk and the others to be training partners for a young man whose fiancée was stolen from him. But the one who stole his fiancée was Tanakiera herself. As she tries to spin the story into a heartwarming tale with the young man, who awakened to his power after his emotions exploded, Alk and the others are left with indescribable feelings.

1161165/1.19:
A martial arts master who is both kind and terrifying. Though she possesses superhuman strength, she's a good person whose hobbies are helping and teaching others.

However, her thought process and priorities are beyond human comprehension. To put it plainly, she doesn't understand the human heart.

5000607/1.19:
An all-around martial art founded by the martial artist Tanakiera, combining armed techniques with unarmed combat.

It shows the path to ultimate martial mastery by awakening the beast within one's heart and honing a fighting spirit close to pure instinct.

Yet the more one masters it, the more one risks being swallowed by the beast raging within--and there is no end to disciples who meet that fate.
